newsitem.title: FRANCE: INTERVIEW - BBDO sees shakeup in French ad industry.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - BBDO sees shakeup in French ad industry.

text.p: The French advertising industry will experience a big shakeup in 1997, said CLM/BBDO chairman Christophe Lambert, who predicts it will be a "fabulous" year for his agency.
"The year 1997 will be key for the business. Lots of things will happen," he told Reuters in an interview.
He said he did not expect mergers among the agencies but rather important changes in their ranks.
"For BBDO the year will be fabulous relative to the past three years when the agency experienced some difficulties through the losses of important clients," he said.

"We had a difficult 1996 but the end of last year and the start of 1997 show an improvement. Big clients like France Telecom or Krys have been signed on and we'll win others in the months ahead," he said.
He said the new team at BBDO worked well and he added that he did not expect big personnel changes.

Lambert also said he wondered whether Havas would keep a finger in the pie -- Havas has a 37 percent stake in Havas Advertising, which controls one of the leading French agencies Euro RSCG -- given its new project to become a communications giant with Generale des Eaux.
Havas last week said it did not expect to change the stake.

As for the other industry leader, Publicis, he said it needs to make "colossal investments in order to survive" and he questioned whether the family controlling the agencies was ready to put up the financing.

"There's a small number of agencies in France of significant size that are well positioned in terms of quality counseling and creativity -- there's BDDP, DDB, BBDO, Saatchi and Saatchi and Young and Rubicam," he said.
He said the advertising market would probably turn out to be flat this year.
